title: THRIVE Routine Schema
description: A recurring structure that stabilizes functioning. First-class object. Defined by THRIVE v1.0.1 §8. v1.1: added optional behavior_design object (habit-loop, cue/reward, implementation intention, habit stacking via anchor_routine_id).

behavior_design.description: Optional. Declares the behavior design structure underlying this routine. Supports habit-loop, implementation-intention, and Tiny Habits-style patterns. Never required for THRIVE conformance.

cue.description: The trigger that initiates this routine. Should be specific and observable.

cue_type.description: The category of cue. 'preceding-action' supports habit stacking — one routine's completion triggers the next.

reward.description: The immediate positive outcome that reinforces this routine. Should be immediate, not delayed.

implementation_intention.description: If-then statement formalizing the cue-routine link: 'When [cue occurs], I will [routine action].' Increases follow-through on intentions.

anchor_routine_id.description: Optional. If cue_type is 'preceding-action', the id of the routine whose completion triggers this one (habit stacking).
